action: Coles customers, staff and suppliers: no action required yet. Watch for official Coles updates, be wary of emails or calls claiming to be about the incident, and suppliers should verify any payment-detail changes by phone.
exec: A major retailer has a live security incident; trading continues and no data loss is confirmed, but the picture may change.
plain: Australian supermarket group Coles says it is dealing with a cyber incident with help from the national cyber agency. Stores and online orders are running normally, and it has found no sign so far that data was taken.
summary: Australia's second-largest retailer told the ASX it is investigating a cyber incident with help from the Australian Cyber Security Centre and outside experts. Stores and online ordering are operating normally, and Coles says it has found no evidence so far that customer, staff or supplier data was taken.
title: Coles Group investigates cyber incident

validation.note: ASX filing reported consistently by several Australian outlets.

review.note: ASX statement, ACSC, normal operations, no evidence of data taken match iTnews and InDaily; 'containing' not in sources, changed to 'investigating'
